speaker: TY
text: [excited, showing off] What if Robux... became REAL money?

speaker: TY
text: [proud] Because for exactly one week... I was the richest kid on the planet.

speaker: TY
text: [giddy] I had a gold hoverboard. A robot butler. And a swimming pool full of COINS.

speaker: THIRTY
text: [nasal, fast] Marketplace fee! Thirty percent!

speaker: TY
text: [annoyed] Not now, Thirty Percent Guy!

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [alarm, robotic] Warning. Robux value: minus ninety-nine percent.

speaker: TY
text: [panicked] No, no, no, no— [screams] NOOO!

speaker: TY
text: [deadpan] ...Yeah. It went great. [pause] Okay. Rewind. Monday morning.

speaker: TY
text: [cheerful, storyteller] Hi. I'm Ty. I'm twelve. And I am the cheapest person you will ever meet.

speaker: TY
text: I have never spent a single Robux. Not on a hat. Not on a pet. Not even on a game pass.

speaker: TY
text: [proud, deadpan] My avatar still wears the free starter shirt. [pause] It's not a look. It's a lifestyle.

speaker: TY
text: I eat the free samples at the supermarket for lunch. I reuse birthday wrapping paper. I once returned a gift... to my own grandma.

speaker: TY
text: [whispers, secretive] Because I had a plan. [pause] The AFK farm.

speaker: TY
text: In second grade, I taped down my spacebar in a clicker game... [pause] and I never turned it off.

speaker: TY
text: [amazed] Four years later, my computer is basically a space heater. [pause] And my balance is... three MILLION Robux.

speaker: MIA
text: [sarcastic, bored] Wow. Three million pixels. Can you buy groceries with pixels?

speaker: TY
text: That's my sister, Mia. She spent every Robux she ever had on hats.

speaker: MIA
text: [offended] Four hundred and twelve hats. It's called FASHION.

speaker: TY
text: And this is my best friend, Pickle.

speaker: TY
text: [aside] He lives next door. He has never once used a door.

speaker: PICKLE
text: [goofy, proud] I have twelve Robux! [pause] I'm saving up for a shoe.

speaker: ANCHOR
text: [breaking news, urgent] Breaking news! Starting today, Robux are officially REAL money!

speaker: ANCHOR
text: One Robux equals one dollar. Effective... right now!

speaker: TY
text: [stunned whisper] One Robux... one dollar. [pause] Three million Robux...

speaker: TY
text: [screams with joy] I'M A MILLIONAIRE!

speaker: ANCHOR
text: [excited] Across the world, gamers are celebrating! Parents are confused! And one man just found forty thousand Robux in his son's old tablet!

speaker: TY
text: [fast, laughing] Kids became richer than their parents overnight. My neighbor's six-year-old bought the ice cream truck. [pause] The whole truck.

speaker: MIA
text: [horrified] Wait. Then my hats... Can I SELL my hats?!

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [cheerful UI voice] Sorry! All sales are final. No refunds!

speaker: MIA
text: [screams] NOOOOO!

speaker: DAD
text: [confused] Kids? Why is the ceiling raining money?

speaker: TY
text: [fast, narrating] Dad never played Roblox in his life. Zero Robux. Mom had five, from a gift card in 2019.

speaker: MOM
text: [calm, pleased] Five dollars. [pause] I'll take it.

speaker: GRANDMA
text: [excited, old lady] Ooh! I've got eight hundred Robux from my obby tournaments!

speaker: TY
text: Yeah. Grandma is better at Roblox than all of us.

speaker: TY
text: [excited, building] And just like that... the whole world switched to Robux.

speaker: TY
text: The bus wanted Robux. The cafeteria wanted Robux. Even the ice cream truck had a Robux price tag.

speaker: TY
text: [disbelief] And then... everything got GAME PASSES.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [chirpy] Supermarket VIP! Double cart speed! Ninety-nine Robux!

speaker: TY
text: [fast, like a sports commentator] Want the short checkout line? Game pass. Want extra fries? Game pass. Want to skip math class?

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [chirpy] Skip Math! Nine hundred ninety-nine Robux!

speaker: PICKLE
text: [gasps] I would literally sell my shoe for that.

speaker: TY
text: You don't HAVE a shoe.

speaker: PICKLE
text: [sad] ...I'm saving up for one.

speaker: TY
text: [fast] The elevator had a "skip floors" pass. The dentist sold a "no drill" pass. My teacher sold a "delete homework" button.

speaker: TY
text: [mock-horror] And Mom found a game pass called "free shipping." [pause] She bought it. For EVERYTHING.

speaker: MOM
text: [satisfied] Even the groceries come by drone now.

speaker: DAD
text: [tired] My boss pays me in Robux now. And the coffee machine is a PREMIUM game pass.

speaker: DAD
text: [outraged] And a promotion costs five thousand Robux! It's a "Manager" rank!

speaker: TY
text: [mysterious, lower voice] And every time anyone paid for anything... HE showed up.

speaker: THIRTY
text: [nasal, fast, gleeful] Marketplace fee! Thirty percent! Thank you, come again!

speaker: TY
text: Nobody knew where he came from. Nobody knew where he went. He just... took thirty percent.

speaker: DAD
text: [outraged] He took thirty percent of my SANDWICH!

speaker: THIRTY
text: [chewing, muffled] Marketplace fee.

speaker: TY
text: [mischievous] So, obviously... I did the responsible thing.

speaker: TY
text: [yells joyfully] I BOUGHT EVERYTHING!

speaker: TY
text: [fast, giddy] A gold hoverboard. Gold sneakers. A gold toothbrush — which tastes terrible, by the way.

speaker: TY
text: A limo with a ball pit. A robot butler named Jeeves Three Thousand.

speaker: BUTLER
text: [robotic, polite, British] Your golden cereal is served, sir.

speaker: TY
text: [proud] And a mansion... with an OBBY in the backyard.

speaker: TY
text: [giddy, faster] A solid gold statue of myself. Four hundred pizzas. I paid a guy to stand in line for me. [pause] Then I paid another guy to stand in line for HIM.

speaker: TY
text: [laughing] And suddenly... I had a LOT of friends.

speaker: TY
text: Kids I'd never met. Kids from other schools. One guy who said he was my cousin from Brazil.

speaker: TY
text: [laughing] They laughed at all my jokes. Even the bad ones. [pause] ESPECIALLY the bad ones.

speaker: TY
text: [guilty, slower] Pickle came too. [pause] But my butler had a VIP list.

speaker: BUTLER
text: [robotic, cold] Twelve Robux is below the minimum, sir.

speaker: PICKLE
text: [small, sad] Oh. [pause] That's okay. I'll just... wait out here.

speaker: TY
text: [quiet, regretful] I should have gone outside. [pause] I didn't.

speaker: TY
text: [uneasy] And every time I bought something... the Thirty Percent Guy got a little... bigger.

speaker: THIRTY
text: [voice a bit deeper] Marketplace fee! [burps] Thirty percent!

speaker: MIA
text: [gasps, then evil grin] Wait. "Sparkle Time Fedora." [pause] LIMITED edition.

speaker: TY
text: [narrating, fast] Turns out, rare hats were now the most valuable thing on Earth. And Mia had a LOT of hats.

speaker: MIA
text: [smug] Who's broke now, little brother?

speaker: TY
text: [defensive] I'm not broke! I'm a MILLIONAIRE!

speaker: MIA
text: [smug] I'm a TWO-millionaire.

speaker: TY
text: [competitive, fast] So I bought a hoverboard. She bought a helicopter. I bought a mansion. She bought the mansion next door. One floor taller.

speaker: MIA
text: [deadpan] I also bought the moon.

speaker: TY
text: [stunned] ...You can't BUY the moon.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [chirpy] Moon purchased! Thirty percent fee applied.

speaker: TY
text: [narrating] Meanwhile, Dad had a brilliant idea.

speaker: DAD
text: [dramatic] If playing games makes money now... I'm quitting my job. I'm going PRO.

speaker: TY
text: [fast] He bought an RGB gaming chair. An RGB headset. And RGB socks.

speaker: DAD
text: [focused, tense] Okay. Jump... jump... JUMP!

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [chirpy] Oof! You died. Attempt three hundred and twelve.

speaker: DAD
text: [screams] The lava is RIGGED!

speaker: TY
text: Dad was terrible. [pause] But Grandma...

speaker: GRANDMA
text: [hyped, streamer voice] What's up, chat! NanaBea here! Speedrun, no jumps, eyes closed! Let's GO!

speaker: TY
text: [impressed] Grandma was the most famous obby streamer in the world. Two million viewers. [pause] She made more in one stream than Dad made in a year.

speaker: DAD
text: [sulking] ...I'm going back to my job.

speaker: GRANDMA
text: [sweet] Bye, sweetie! Like and subscribe!

speaker: TY
text: [dramatic] But real money... brought real problems.

speaker: SCAMMER
text: [smooth, oily] Good evening, ma'am! FREE ROBUX! Just tell me your password, and I'll DOUBLE your Robux!

speaker: GRANDMA
text: [delighted] Ooh, double! [pause] Well, my password is "password"...

speaker: TY
text: [shouts] GRANDMA, NO!

speaker: TY
text: [running, fast] I KNEW that guy! He's the "free Robux" scam from every game chat EVER!

speaker: SCAMMER
text: [panicked] Free Robux! Free Robux! Click my link!

speaker: TY
text: [dodging, fast] "Robux generator, one hundred percent real!" "You won a free hat!" "Verify your account!" [pause] Nope! Nope! NOPE!

speaker: TY
text: [panting] If Robux are real money... then scamming is a REAL crime!

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [booming] User reported. [pause] BANNED.

speaker: SCAMMER
text: [being dragged away] I'll be back! With a better link!

speaker: GRANDMA
text: [sheepish] I just wanted a cool hat for my obby stream.

speaker: TY
text: [warm, firm] Grandma. Never. Share. Your password.

speaker: GRANDMA
text: [nods] Okay, sweetie. [pause] It's "password two" now.

speaker: TY
text: [facepalm] ...Grandma.

speaker: TY
text: [cheerful, then slowing down] Everything was perfect. Until... Wednesday.

speaker: TY
text: [confused] On Monday, bread cost five Robux. On Tuesday... fifty.

speaker: TY
text: [alarmed] On Wednesday... five THOUSAND.

speaker: MOM
text: [shocked] Five thousand Robux? For BREAD?!

speaker: TY
text: [clear, explaining] Here's what happened. Every day, eight billion people claimed their free daily rewards. And every reward printed brand-new Robux.

speaker: TY
text: So everyone had way more money... but there was still the same amount of bread.

speaker: TY
text: And when everyone has more money, but there's the same amount of stuff... [pause] the stuff just gets more expensive.

speaker: MIA
text: [flat, smug] That's called inflation. [pause] We learned it in school. You'd know if you didn't buy "Skip Math."

speaker: TY
text: [groans] Ugh. She's right.

speaker: TY
text: [panicking, fast] By Thursday, a pack of gum cost a MILLION Robux. People pushed wheelbarrows full of coins to the store.

speaker: TY
text: The news anchor's tie was worth more than his car. Dad's whole paycheck bought one coffee. [pause] With thirty percent missing.

speaker: DAD
text: [crying, sipping] It's the best coffee I've ever had.

speaker: ANCHOR
text: [panicking] Breaking news! Prices are going up so fast, this news is already more expensive than when I started reading it!

speaker: MIA
text: [screams] My fedora is worth ZERO! Who wants a MOON?!

speaker: TY
text: [devastated] And my three million Robux? [pause] They bought me... one sandwich.

speaker: TY
text: [desperate] I tried to sell the gold toothbrush. [pause] Nobody wanted a used gold toothbrush.

speaker: THIRTY
text: [huge, booming] MARKETPLACE FEE!

speaker: TY
text: [screams] HALF a sandwich!

speaker: BUTLER
text: [robotic, cold] Sir, your payment has failed. I now work for your neighbor.

speaker: TY
text: [defeated, narrating] My butler quit. My limo got taken away. And my mansion...

speaker: THIRTY
text: [giant, booming, gleeful] Belongs to ME! Thirty percent of EVERYTHING is MINE!

speaker: TY
text: [narrating, grim] He'd been taking thirty percent of every purchase on Earth. [pause] Now he owned the tallest building in the city.

speaker: TY
text: [quiet] ...And that's how I ended up in a box.

speaker: PICKLE
text: [warm] Hey, Ty. [pause] Want to share my umbrella?

speaker: TY
text: [ashamed, soft] Pickle... I didn't even let you into my party.

speaker: PICKLE
text: [simple, sincere] Yeah. [pause] But you're still my best friend.

speaker: TY
text: [voice cracking] ...I'm sorry, Pickle.

speaker: PICKLE
text: [cheerful] I know. [pause] Also, my sock is wet. Can we sit somewhere drier?

speaker: MIA
text: [determined] Okay, losers. We've got a problem. [pause] Look at this.

speaker: MIA
text: The Robux Printer. Every daily reward in the world comes out of this one machine. And it's running at a thousand percent.

speaker: TY
text: [realizing] So if we turn it off... prices stop going up!

speaker: PICKLE
text: [nervous] And the Thirty Percent Guy? He's been taking thirty percent of EVERYTHING.

speaker: TY
text: [grim] That's why he's the size of a building.

speaker: MIA
text: [smirks] So... who wants to rob a bank?

speaker: TY
text: [determined] Technically, we're UN-robbing it. [pause] Let's go.

speaker: GRANDMA
text: [hyped] You need a distraction? Leave that to me, sweetie. [pause] Chat! We're going LIVE in front of the bank!

speaker: DAD
text: [proud] And I'll drive the getaway car! [pause] Very carefully. Under the speed limit.

speaker: TY
text: [epic, building] The Central Bank of Robux was one giant obby.

speaker: TY
text: [fast, commentator] Coin avalanches! Floors made of price tags that went UP while you stood on them! Laser scanners that charged you a fee just for LOOKING at them!

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [chirpy] Scan complete! Fee: one hat.

speaker: MIA
text: [outraged] NOT THE BERET!

speaker: TY
text: [straining] A wall of bills! A conveyor belt of debt! And a coin avalanche right on top of—

speaker: TY
text: [shouts] MIA! Grab my hand!

speaker: MIA
text: [coughing, then quietly] ...Thanks. [pause] Don't tell anyone I said that.

speaker: TY
text: [fast, panicked] And then... the Thirty Percent Guy's interns showed up. Hundreds of tiny Thirty Percent Guys!

speaker: THIRTY
text: [tiny, many voices, chaotic] Fee! Fee! Fee! Fee! Fee!

speaker: PICKLE
text: [panicked] They're taking thirty percent of my SOCK!

speaker: TY
text: [awed] At the very top... the Robux Printer. [pause] And guarding it...

speaker: THIRTY
text: [giant, booming] Every coin! Every trade! Every SANDWICH! Thirty percent belongs to ME!

speaker: TY
text: [scared] He's too big! We can't beat him!

speaker: PICKLE
text: [suddenly brave] Wait. [pause] I have an idea.

speaker: PICKLE
text: Hey, Mister Thirty. I want to buy something. [pause] For twelve Robux.

speaker: THIRTY
text: [greedy, booming] A purchase?! Marketplace fee! Thirty percent of twelve is...

speaker: THIRTY
text: [calculating, slowing down] Three... point... six.

speaker: THIRTY
text: [panicking] Three point SIX?! But Robux don't have DECIMALS!

speaker: THIRTY
text: [glitching, robotic stutter] Does not compute... does not COMPUTE!

speaker: TY
text: [laughing, disbelief] Pickle... you beat him with MATH!

speaker: PICKLE
text: [proud] I never skipped math class.

speaker: MIA
text: [snorts] Burn.

speaker: SYSTEM
text: [calm, serious] Reset economy? [pause] All Robux will turn back into game currency. [pause] Your three million Robux will become... just Robux.

speaker: TY
text: [hesitating, soft] Three million...

speaker: TY
text: [reflective] I thought about the mansion. The gold toothbrush. The hundred friends who vanished as soon as the money did.

speaker: TY
text: [pause] And then I looked at the two people who stayed.

speaker: TY
text: [soft] The friend who waited outside my party in one shoe. [pause] And the sister who came back for me in the rain.

speaker: PICKLE
text: [encouraging] Whatever you pick, Ty... I'll still share my umbrella with you.

speaker: MIA
text: [softer than usual] ...Yeah. Me too. [pause] Don't make it weird.

speaker: TY
text: [determined, shouts] RESET!

speaker: TY
text: [warm] The next morning, everything was normal again.

speaker: ANCHOR
text: [cheerful] Good news, everyone! Robux are once again just a fun game currency. And bread is back to two dollars!

speaker: TY
text: Dad got paid in real dollars. Mom used her coupons. And Grandma changed her password. [pause] For real this time.

speaker: DAD
text: [joyful, sipping] The coffee machine is FREE again!

speaker: TY
text: And Grandma's stream still gets two million viewers. [pause] She does charity streams now.

speaker: GRANDMA
text: [proud] It's "password three"!

speaker: TY
text: [sighs] ...We're working on it.

speaker: MIA
text: [content] And my four hundred and twelve hats are worth exactly nothing again. [pause] I've never been happier.

speaker: TY
text: And me? [pause] I'm broke again. [laughs] Totally, completely broke.

speaker: PICKLE
text: [warm] Here. One Robux. For your next mansion.

speaker: TY
text: [touched] ...Thanks, Pickle. [pause] I'm spending it on a shoe. For you.

speaker: PICKLE
text: [gasps happily] A SHOE?!

speaker: MIA
text: [grudging] For the record... you were a pretty okay millionaire. [pause] For like a day.

speaker: TY
text: [smiling] Thanks, Mia.

speaker: ANCHOR
text: [breaking news] This just in! Starting tomorrow... EVERY video game coin becomes real money!

speaker: PICKLE
text: [excited] I have twelve of those too!

speaker: TY
text: [deadpan, to camera] ...Oh no.

speaker: TY
text: [to camera, upbeat] So... what would YOU buy if Robux became real money? Tell me in the comments!

speaker: TY
text: And remember: never share your password. [pause] Not even "password three."
